metadata.artist_html: Auli Raha (অলি রাহা)
metadata.description_html: This is unmissable! Wintertime, starting from October to January is when the orange ripens and the cultivation begins in mid-December. Enjoy the surreal beauty of the quaint orange orchards. The fruit-laden trees turn appealing in eye-soothing yellow color. Make sure to relish the sweet citrusy oranges! Likewise, you can learn about orange cultivation from the cheerful farmers.
